messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected for tenant 'MeridianApps' on dedicated-cluster eu-west-2. metric: 5xx/sec=320 (baseline ~5). Trigger: gateway-error-rate > 50% for 2m. Page: oncall. link: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/5632100000
Anna (oncall): paging @Ryan @Maria — I'm oncall for today. MeridianApps reporting widespread 502/504s from their customers in eu-west-2. Root: dedicated pool.
Kevin (Meridian Ops): Confirmed from our end — multiple customer sessions failing since 11:02 UTC. Ticket RED-12345 opened. Customers see 502s and timeouts on important flows.
Anna (oncall): gathering traces & impact. @Sabah can you pull gateway logs + cluster utilization?
Ryan (infra): grabbing logs now. Quick snapshot: ded-eu2-gpu-07 shows GPU util 98%, node load 9.2, repeated KV eviction spikes. tail logs: 
```
[11:02:21] gateway -> backend: 502 upstream timeout
[11:02:22] runtime: queue_inflight=2781 queue_capacity=1024
[11:02:24] kvclient: eviction_count=421 errors=120
```

Maria (sre): I'm seeing many backend 504s mapping to slow KV reads. p99 KV latency jumped from 12ms -> 1.4s. This matches gateway timeouts -> 5xx cascade. Likely noisy neighbor or a model causing KV thrash.
Dmitri (eng-runtime): runtime metrics show per-model slot backlog correlated with a single heavy job from tenant 'TalosAI' on same node. KV miss rate + cache churn up ~40%. Posting quick telemetry excerpt: 
```
metric: queue.backlog  -> host=ded-eu2-gpu-07 value=2781
metric: kv.latency_p99  -> host=ded-eu2-gpu-07 value=1400ms
metric: model.inflight  -> model=talos-large value=18 (capacity 4)
```
Anna (oncall): immediate mitigation suggestions? Throttle MeridianApps? Evict noisy client? Spin up capacity?
Sabah (eng): I can push a soft route throttle for MeridianApps at the gateway to cap RPS and avoid p99 blowups. Command I will run: 
```
rbctl route update --tenant=meridian --rate=60
```
Sabah (eng): pushing throttle now.
Ryan (infra): starting a soft-eviction of the top noisy client on ded-eu2-gpu-07 (evicting Talos large jobs to reduce KV pressure). Cmd: 
```
evict-client --node=ded-eu2-gpu-07 --client=talos --soft=true --max-drain-secs=30
```
Kevin (Meridian Ops): If you evict Talos, some of their long-running inferences will fail. Our customers prefer degraded service over a full outage — they asked for conservative mitigations only.
Maria (sre): also seeing autoscaler isn't kicking due to quota headroom = 0. We can either move spare nodes from staging or ask infra to override quotas. @Ryan?
Ryan (infra): I have 2 staging nodes I can move into the dedicated pool temporarily. Initiating node transfer — ETA ~4m.
Dmitri (eng-runtime): while scaling happens I enabled prefix caching for MeridianApps to reduce KV lookups for hot prefixes. Command run: 
```
runtime-config set-cache --tenant=meridian --mode=prefix --ttl=30m
```
incident-bot: Action updates: soft-eviction started by Ryan at 5632100120. throttle applied by Sabah at 5632100115. scale action initiated by Ryan at 5632100125.
Sabah (eng): throttle active — MeridianApps steady RPS ~55, 5xx rate dropped from ~55% -> ~12% in last 30s.
Maria (sre): after soft-eviction KV eviction_count trending down, queue backlog reduced from 2781 -> 1200. p99 latency improved to ~420ms.
Dmitri (eng-runtime): extra worker nodes came up and joined pool at 5632100245. inflight/capacity ratio back under 1.2.
Anna (oncall): immediate indicators: 5xx rate now 3% over last 2m, customer reports decreasing error pages. Recommend keeping throttle + monitoring for 30m and then gradually relax.
Kevin (Meridian Ops): I'll update the support ticket and status page: "mitigation in place, availability improving, investigating root cause and next steps". Will notify key customers.
Sabah (eng): follow-ups: 1) keep route throttle for 30m, 2) run eviction analysis to detect noisy tenants, 3) increase autoscaler headroom for dedicated pools to prevent cold-start delays.
Ryan (infra): I'll file infra action: increase quota buffer for eu-west-2 dedicated pool and add playbook for hot-node draining.
Maria (sre): handoff to next oncall @Maria (me) — I'll watch for 2 hours and run RCA with Dmitri.
Dmitri (eng-runtime): preliminary root cause: co-located heavy job (Talos large) produced KV thrash + queue saturation on a single node; autoscaler headroom insufficient; customer config pinned model preventing automatic fallback. We'll include these in the postmortem.
Anna (oncall): thanks all. Keeping channel open; will close when next oncall confirms stability. :white_check_mark:
